name: Rosewood Beijing
positioning: Contemporary city hotel at Jing Guang Centre in Beijing with a residential feel, a Michelin-starred Cantonese restaurant and a heated indoor pool
best_for: Food lovers who want Michelin-recognised Chinese restaurants in the hotel
Travelers interested in Beijing's contemporary art scene

facts.text: The House of Dynasties serves Cantonese dim sum in a grand dynastic setting.
At The House of Dynasties, Zhanjiang flavours are prepared with seasonal, sustainably sourced ingredients.
Country Kitchen serves Northern Chinese cuisine.
Butterfly Patisserie serves fresh pastries and cakes during the day and cocktails at night.
The spa is Sense, A Rosewood Spa, which offers a Sand and Wood Massage based on Beijing's pat therapy massage.
The Rosewood Suite has a living room, an enclosed bedroom and a half bath.
Guest rooms combine traditional materials with modern design.
The design balances contemporary style with subtle references to Chinese craftsmanship and history.
The hotel is at Jing Guang Centre, Hu Jia Lou, Beijing.
Country Kitchen is a Michelin-selected restaurant in the Michelin Guide Beijing 2024-2026.

highlights.text: The House of Dynasties is a one-star restaurant in the Michelin Guide Beijing 2025-2026.
Dark woods, curated art and shelves of curios and books give the hotel the feel of a private residence.
The hotel has a heated indoor pool with jacuzzi access, views and curated art.
Red Bowl is a hot pot restaurant where guests can eat at the bar or in a private room.

Guest rooms have marble bathrooms, deep soaking tubs and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the city skyline; the hotel also offers a 798 Contemporary Art Tour of Beijing's contemporary art galleries.

considerations.text: The hotel is a city address at Jing Guang Centre in Beijing, and its pool is indoors.
WhataHotel notes limited recreational facilities compared to resort properties.
